CLOUD DESIGN-REVISION seat (revision 3) for the combined CI design (group R10-CI-LAYOUT) of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor.
Inputs: revision 2 `probe/design-ci-rev2` (d775cc6c), round-3 review `probe/design-ci-review3` (f731b201, REVIEW.md + ev/ + its tools/, verdict revise), and the earlier reviews `probe/design-ci-review2` and `probe/design-ci-review`. Read them in full, plus CLAUDE.md, judge.md, ci-autofix.md, gate-scoping.md and orchestrator.md from origin/main.
Task: resolve R3-1, the blocking item, exactly as the review's 'What would turn this into approve' states: the sweep cannot leave a running older gate attempt red; the read is the gate's last step; gate_sim.py gains a TAIL arm; and REV2 scores 0 END-BAD over it, re-run with the reviewer's tools/timing_perturb.py too. ALSO resolve R3-2, R3-3, R3-4 and the editorial points: this programme defers no finding. For R3-2, document the platform fact or remove the dependency. For R3-3, check a gained step's position. For R3-4, handle fork PRs or state soundly why they cannot occur here. For R3-5, write `## R-10 owner question` stating the question, each option with its consequence, and your recommended option. Keep everything else in revision 2 as it is, unless a fix forces a change, and if one does, say so. Add `## Round-3 item <id>` sections to RESPONSE.md.
Return: commit the revised DESIGN-P1.md, DESIGN-P2.md, measure/ and RESPONSE.md, and push ONLY `refs/heads/probe/design-ci-rev3`. No PRs, comments or workflow edits on real branches. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or refusal; report it.
